claims.claim: packc compile and compile-prompt both create the output directory (writePackFile)
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
packc compile flags: -c/--config (default config.arena.yaml), -o/--output (default <id>.pack.json), --id (default current folder name sanitized), --pack-version (default v1.0.0)
packc validate validates every file argument and exits 1 if any fails
two compiles of the same inputs differ only in compilation.created_at; template_engine resolved deterministically, disagreement is a compile error
